node.title: L1 received-word barycentric Q scope fence
node.statement: For every a-support A and received word U, vanishing of the top w=a-k coefficients of I_A(U) is equivalent to the w barycentric moments sum_(x in A) U(x)x^j/L_A'(x)=0. These weights depend on the complete moving support. A depth-one F_7 witness has two supports with the same locator prefix and different received-word prefixes, and a nonzero four-support exchange defect excludes a literal affine fixed-column representation. Therefore upstream locator-prefix row-sharp Q does not directly apply to L1 exact shells; the global route requires a new received-word barycentric prefix-flatness theorem or an explicit map-and-owner transport. This does not exclude nonlinear or chart-specific transport.
